name: Shinonome Ririka
source:
[b]The ex-gyaru mom who unknowingly warped the protagonist’s tastes[/b]

Suzu’s mother, a former gyaru herself.
After separating from her husband, she returned to her previous job as a teacher. She currently works at the school as the advisor for the fashion design club. When Hatsune was about to transfer schools due to his parents' circumstances, Tsukune—who was close friends with Suzu—threw a fit, not wanting to be apart from him. As a result, he ended up living with them.

Lately, since her actual daughter Suzu has been busy with part-time work, she’s been doting on Tsukune like he were her own child. Back when she was a student, she was close friends with Mana’s mother, and the two used to cosplay together.

She also happens to be the main reason Hatsune’s preferences turned out the way they did—but she’s completely unaware of that.




•Her birthday it's the same day as the "Mother's Day"
•She is good at: Cooking, cosplay (not doing it anymore).
•She is bad at: Organizing, sports.

[i]"You admired me...? That’s such a sweet thing to say~♪"[/i]
